objective: Determine why the five Chohogi Codex roles were absent from ~/.codex/config.toml, classify whether that absence is an installation defect, register them under the user's explicit authorization, and verify discovery and real role delegation in fresh Codex sessions.
requested: report the causal reason for absent Codex role registration
decide whether the current install path is defective
register all five canonical role TOMLs in ~/.codex/config.toml
run paid live Codex verification using gpt-5.6-luna
excluded: reading credentials or unrelated personal configuration
claiming plugin installation alone registers roles before a fresh-session test proves it

requestedItems.description: Trace the role-introduction decision, current plugin schema, installer behavior, and documentation boundary.
Add the five [agents.<role>] config_file entries that reference canonical repository TOMLs.
Validate TOML parsing and fresh Codex discovery without a run-only -c role override.
Run real gpt-5.6-luna adherence scenarios and record role-spawn evidence.
State the smallest durable source repair needed if native Codex plugin installation cannot register roles.

acceptance.description: All five canonical roles are present in ~/.codex/config.toml and the file parses as TOML.
Fresh Codex evidence shows role discovery/delegation with no --codex-role-config override.
The report distinguishes native Codex limits from Chohogi's installer/discovery failure.
